Name: THRUSTERS_PARAM_NPC_ST
Description: Thruster particle effects for NPCs. Each row sets, for every thruster slot (main, front/back/left/right, Quick Boost, lift, brake and unique slots), the particle effect, its management slot and how it follows the dummy poly and the movement direction.

Fields.Name: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Dummy poly the particle effects spawn at. -1: the placement position. Dummy poly IDs range from 0 to 999; the 1000s and 10000s digits are the category number.

Fields.Name: Main: SFX ID
Fields.Description: Particle ID of this thruster's particle effect.

Fields.Name: Main: Slot Number
Fields.Description: Management slot number of the particle effect. -1: not managed. Don't use a looping particle effect without a management slot.

Fields.Name: Main: RPC Type
Fields.Description: RPC used to vary the particle effect (for example its size) with the character's horizontal movement speed. With 1, the value actually used is 60000.

Fields.Name: Main: Direction Mode
Fields.Description: 0: keep the dummy poly's direction. 1: align horizontally.

Fields.Name: Main: Follow Dummy Polygon
Fields.Description: If ON, the particle effect follows the dummy poly.

Fields.Name: Main: Delete SFX on End of Action
Fields.Description: If ON, the particle effect is removed when the action ends.

Fields.Name: Main: Show While Hidden
Fields.Description: If ON, the particle effect stays visible while the character is hidden (camouflaged). If OFF, it disappears.

Fields.Name: Main: Correction Direction based on Movement
Fields.Description: Used to change the direction of the dummy poly according to the character's movement direction.

Fields.Name: Main: Correction Limit Angle: X
Fields.Description: Maximum X angle the dummy poly direction is corrected by when turning it towards the movement direction.

Fields.Name: Main: Correction Limit Angle: Y
Fields.Description: Maximum Y angle the dummy poly direction is corrected by when turning it towards the movement direction.

Fields.Name: Main: SFX Scale
Fields.Description: Scale of the particle effect.
